experiments.label: RATES_US_TREASURY_VS_STIR_SWAP_SPREAD_PROXY
experiments.economic_mechanism: The spread between a government bond yield and the collateralised/interbank rate of the same tenor is not curve shape. It is the price of balance sheet, collateral scarcity and the government-versus-interbank funding basis. Long a Treasury future against a beta-matched short-rate future isolates it.
experiments.instruments: leg 1 = ZN / ZF / ZB (TREASURY_FUTURES, certified layer, 1982+). leg 2 = SR3 (3-month SOFR, 2018+) or ZQ (30-day Fed Funds, 1988+), both present in the R41 curve store and ABSENT from the R38 certified 68-market layer.
experiments.is_not_an_otc_swap: A short-rate futures strip is NOT an interest-rate swap. No fixed/floating exchange, no swap curve discounting, no CSA, and no convexity adjustment. This cell is a declared EXCHANGE-TRADED PROXY and may never be reported as the Treasury/swap trade the operator named.

experiments.label: XA_TERMS_OF_TRADE_COMMODITY_CURRENCY_RV
experiments.economic_mechanism: A commodity exporter's currency and its export commodity share one terms-of-trade factor. The hedged pair holds the currency against a beta-matched basket of the commodity it exports, so the common factor cancels and what remains is the relative mispricing of the two claims on the same economic state.
experiments.instruments: 6A/6C/6N (FX_FUTURES) against GC/HG (metals) and CL (energy), all in the certified layer.
experiments.burden_warning: CROSS_ASSET carries 2,448 prior tests - the estate's largest denominator.
